sentence_stem: What the committee had failed to consider
correct_completion: was the long-term cost of the proposal.
full_sentence: What the committee had failed to consider was the long-term cost of the proposal.
acceptable_variants: was the impact on future budgets.
was how much the project would ultimately cost.

options.text: the long-term cost of the proposal.
options.why_wrong: The clause has no linking verb. A wh-clause used as a subject needs a verb such as 'was' to connect it to its complement.

options.text: was considering the long-term cost of the proposal.
options.why_wrong: A progressive verb describes an ongoing action, but this structure is an identifying statement of the form 'what X was Y', where the complement is a noun phrase.

options.text: was the long-term cost of the proposal.
that the long-term cost of the proposal.
options.why_wrong: 'That' can introduce a noun clause as an object, but after a wh-clause subject it cannot take the place of the linking verb, so the sentence stays ungrammatical.

explanation: A wh-nominal clause used as the subject needs one linking verb such as 'was' before its complement. Learners often add a second main verb or a conjunction at this point, which breaks the structure.
translation: O que o comitê não havia considerado era o custo a longo prazo da proposta.
